findings.title: Production deploy created `users_select USING (true)` exposing all users (fixed)
findings.note: SEC-P0-001 closed; current policy is workspace-co-member scoped.

findings.title: Seed workflow could re-open global user RLS / seed shared-password accounts (fixed)
findings.note: PR #88 plus the seed workflow now states production seeding is intentionally disabled.
findings.impact: Previously production RLS/data could be mutated out-of-band.

findings.title: Tracked credential file `test-signin.json` (fixed)
findings.note: Only test-signin.example.json is tracked at a62e44a.
evidence: git ls-files | grep test-signin => test-signin.example.json only

findings.title: Admin user directory / audit logs / compliance exports were not tenant-scoped (fixed)
SSH was open to the internet by default (fixed)
findings.note: `ssh_allowed_ips` is now required and 0.0.0.0/0 is rejected by validation.

findings.title: `WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is not delivered by the production compose stack
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot SEC-P2-003 at a62e44a; key is optional in env.ts.
findings.impact: With the key unset, webhook-secret encryption fails at runtime; with it set only in one service, API/worker diverge.
findings.recommendation: Add WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY to infra/docker/.env.prod.example and the prod compose for api and worker.

findings.title: Webhook SSRF validation does not constrain redirects or DNS rebinding
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot SEC-P2-002; validateWebhookUrl resolves DNS then delivery fetches later.
evidence: no redirect:'manual'/max-redirect or re-resolution guard on the delivery fetch
findings.impact: A public host can 3xx-redirect (or rebind) to an internal address after validation.
findings.recommendation: Set redirect:'manual' (or re-validate every hop) and re-resolve/pin the IP used for the request.

report:
Security/authz/tenancy pass. Verified the
deploy/seed RLS weakening is gone, the seed workflow's production target is
disabled, admin user directory and audit-log/compliance endpoints are
workspace-scoped, SSH is restricted by CIDR, and webhook secrets are
encrypted at rest. New residual: `WEBHOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is not delivered by
the production compose stack, and webhook SSRF still ignores redirects.
